product_overview: Saptaswara is a browser-based Indian classical music studio that lets users explore ragas, compose with a polyphonic step sequencer and virtual instruments, and consult an AI assistant trained in raga theory. The app includes a raga library, project management, and MIDI export for user compositions.
core_goals: Explore and load traditional ragas to hear and compose within their aroha/avaroha constraints
Compose melodic and rhythmic patterns using a virtual piano, drum pads, and a step sequencer
Get raga-aware guidance from an AI assistant to learn theory and get musical suggestions
Save and manage personal compositions/projects in a user dashboard
Export compositions as standard MIDI files for offline use or further production

features.name: Raga Guided Studio
features.description: Compose and play within a raga using the virtual piano, drum pads, and a step sequencer; switch instruments and audition different timbres while the studio enforces raga note sets.
user_flows: Navigate to /studio -> Select a raga to load its notes -> Play the virtual piano or drum pads to add musical material -> Toggle steps on the sequencer grid to build a repeating pattern -> Change instruments to audition different timbres -> Start playback and hear the composition
Navigate to /studio -> Select a raga to load its notes -> Toggle drone on -> Play the virtual piano or drum pads to establish the tonic -> Stop playback and hear recording saved to local session

features.name: AI Assistant (Raga-aware Chat)
features.description: Ask a chat assistant trained on Indian classical music for guidance, streaming swara-aware responses that reference raga context when provided.
user_flows: Navigate to /studio -> Type a musical question in the chat assistant -> Submit the question -> Receive streaming swara-aware responses appended to the chat
Navigate to /studio -> Type an empty message into the chat assistant -> Submit the message -> See a validation error indicating the message cannot be empty

features.name: Raga Library Browser
features.description: Browse the raga database to read notes, aroha/avaroha and metadata, then open a selected raga in the studio for composition and practice.
user_flows: Navigate to /library -> Browse raga cards and read raga details (aroha, avaroha, mood, tradition) -> Select a raga to open in the studio -> Navigate to /studio -> See the selected raga loaded into the studio

features.name: Project Management (Dashboard)
features.description: Save, list, open, and delete user compositions (projects) from a personal dashboard; saved projects include composition metadata and layers.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Initiate project creation -> Provide a title for the project -> Select a raga for the project -> Save the project -> See the new project listed on the dashboard

Navigate to /dashboard -> Open an existing project -> Navigate to /studio -> Make composition changes in the studio -> Save composition as project update -> Return to /dashboard -> See the project updated
Navigate to /dashboard -> Initiate project creation -> Leave the title empty -> Select a raga -> Attempt to save the project -> See a validation error indicating title is required

features.name: Export Composition as MIDI
features.description: Convert the current composition (layers, BPM, events) into a standard MIDI file that the user can download.
user_flows: Navigate to /studio -> Ensure composition has at least one layer and bpm within allowed range -> Export composition as MIDI -> Receive and download a MIDI file
Navigate to /studio -> Set composition bpm below allowed minimum (e.g., 50) -> Attempt to export composition as MIDI -> See a validation error indicating bpm must be between 60 and 200

features.name: Authentication (Email/Password Login)
features.description: Sign in with email and password to access authenticated surfaces (projects dashboard and saved data).
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit credentials -> See the dashboard (/dashboard) after successful login
Navigate to /login -> Enter incorrect email or password -> Submit credentials -> See an authentication error indicating credentials are invalid
